project_name.justification: The primary project of interest is named in the title of the press releases: 'Volt Carbon Technologies Enters into Arm's Length Option Agreement with Green Battery Minerals for the Berkwood Graphite Project' and 'Green Battery and ESG-friendly Battery Developer Volt Carbon Technologies to co-develop the Berkwood Graphite Project'.

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified in the first sentence: 'Volt Carbon Technologies Inc. (TSXV: VCT) (OTCQB: TORVF) (BERLIN: WNF) is pleased to announce that it has entered into an arm's length option agreement with Green Battery Minerals Inc. ... for Volt to acquire an interest in GEM's Berkwood Graphite Project...'

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer, Volt Carbon Technologies Inc., is identified at the end of the first press release: 'V-Bond Lee, P. Eng. CEO, President, Chairman of the Board and Director'.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The agreement grants an option for a specific percentage: 'GEM has agreed to: (i) grant Volt an option to acquire an undivided five percent (5%) interest in the Property that is exercisable until December 31, 2025 (the "Property Option")'.

primary_commodity.justification: The project is explicitly identified as a graphite project: '...for Volt to acquire an interest in GEM's Berkwood Graphite Project...'

verified_article_link.justification: The article is directly about the transaction for the Berkwood project, as stated in the headline: 'Volt Carbon Technologies Enters into Arm's Length Option Agreement with Green Battery Minerals for the Berkwood Graphite Project'.

currency.justification: The buyer, Volt Carbon Technologies Inc., is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (TSXV: VCT), a Canadian exchange. The use of the '$' symbol in this context implies Canadian Dollars (CAD).

cash_payments_raw.justification: A cash payment is required to exercise the option: 'Should Volt choose to exercise the Property Option, in addition to the Exploration Expenditures, Volt will be required to make a cash payment of $1,500,000 to GEM.'

share_payments_raw.justification: The buyer, Volt Carbon Technologies, is not paying with its own shares. Instead, it is receiving shares from the seller (Green Battery Minerals) as part of the agreement: '...issue 4,000,000 shares of GEM to Volt (the "Shares")'.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The consideration is broken down into separate cash and exploration commitments, so this combined field is not applicable as per the extraction hierarchy.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The buyer, Volt Carbon Technologies, is not issuing its own shares as part of the consideration.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: There is no mention of share warrants being issued as part of the consideration.

option_payments_raw.justification: There is no mention of stock options being issued as part of the consideration.

issued_share_price.justification: The buyer, Volt Carbon Technologies, is not issuing its own shares, so there is no associated issue price.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The exploration commitment is specified as a monetary value, not a drilling meterage.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: Volt has agreed to fund exploration on the property as part of the consideration: 'As consideration for the Property Option and the Shares, Volt has agreed to expend $150,000 on the Property (the "Exploration Expenditures") prior to December 31, 2024.'

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: There is no mention of a Net Smelter Royalty (NSR) or Gross Revenue Royalty (GRR) being acquired or retained as part of the transaction terms.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The text does not specify the size of the Berkwood Graphite Project in hectares or square kilometers.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The text does not specify the size of the Berkwood Graphite Project in hectares or square kilometers.

resource_size.value: 1,755,300 tonnes of indicated resources at 17.00 % Cgr and 1,526,400 tonnes in inferred resources at 16.39 % Cgr
resource_size.justification: The second article details the mineral resource for the project: 'The current mineral resource at Green Batteries Berkwood Graphite Project includes in-pit constrained resource totalling 1,755,300 tonnes of indicated resources at 17.00 % Cgr and 1,526,400 tonnes in inferred resources at 16.39 % Cgr.'

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer's ticker and exchange are provided in the first sentence of the press release: 'Volt Carbon Technologies Inc. (TSXV: VCT)'.
